name: Wakefield Park
label: Wakefield Park (1994 to 2022 layout)
caveat: As mapped: the 1994 to 2022 layout, traced roughly in OpenStreetMap and not verified. The circuit was rebuilt in 2023 and 2024 and now runs as One Raceway on a different layout.
